dossier.headline: ABB India slips as margins narrow despite record orders
dossier.summary: ABB India's July–September revenue rose about 19% to ₹3,738 crore and order inflows hit a record ₹4,733 crore, but its operating EBITA margin fell to 12.9% from 13.4%. The company cited commodity, logistics and currency costs and pricing pressure, and the stock fell about 3% on Monday.
why_it_matters: Margin pressure is overshadowing strong order growth
The order backlog of ₹12,927 crore supports future revenue
watch: Whether margins recover as commodity costs ease
Broker rating changes after the results
questions: How quickly will the record order book convert to revenue?
conflicts: Reported net profit ranges from ₹440 crore (up 11%, Business Standard) to ₹442.5–443 crore (up about 8%, other reports)
